items.headline: HIGH COURT DECLINES SCHEME OF ARRANGEMENT
items.insight: Permanent TSB Group Holdings PLC's scheme of arrangement failed after the High Court declined sanction in November. This halts the acquisition process initiated in October.

items.headline: Interim analysis of the G308 paediatric study
items.insight: Following the Nov 2026 admission cancellation proposals, this interim analysis is critical. It likely determines whether the proposed cancellation proceeds or if the company continues trading.

items.headline: Bulletin from Netel Holding AB (publ)’s Extra...
items.insight: The merger with Infrea is now complete, creating Netelinfra. This follows the October completion of regulatory and meeting steps.

items.headline: Babcock signs record £8.7billion Gateway Agreement
items.insight: The record Gateway Agreement follows the HY27 results and bridging extension, signaling a major strategic shift or transaction. Shareholders should anticipate significant corporate action or restructuring.

items.headline: Material Uplift to Private Portfolio Company
items.insight: RTW Venture Fund Limited NPV (GBP) confirms a transformative exit for Corxel US via its planned merger with Amanat. This follows earlier disclosures of the deal and subsequent capital allocation updates.
